question: When was the ‘The Objective Resolution’ moved by Pt. Jawahar Lal Nehru?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Fri Dec 13 1946 00:00:00 GMT+0530 (India Standard Time)**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Objective Resolution** was moved by Pt. Jawahar Lal Nehru on **Fri Dec 13 1946 00:00:00 GMT+0530 (India Standard Time)**.
 
• This resolution laid down the fundamentals and philosophy of the constitutional structure of India.
 
• It proclaimed India as an independent sovereign republic and outlined the aspirations of the Indian people to secure justice, equality, and liberty for all citizens.
 
• The Objective Resolution was later adopted by the Constituent Assembly and became the preamble of the Constitution of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Objective Resolution** was a significant step in the framing of the Indian Constitution.
 
• It was a reflection of the aspirations and values that the founding fathers of the nation held dear.
 
• The resolution emphasized the values of **sovereignty, democracy, and republicanism**.
 
• It also highlighted the need for social, economic, and political justice for all citizens.
 
• The adoption of the Objective Resolution was a momentous occasion in the history of India's independence movement.
